title: Esc during a PreToolUse hook reports 'the permission check failed (context canceled)'
observed: After Esc interrupts a slow PreToolUse hook, the bash block reads: '→ the permission check failed (context canceled), so the call did not run.' The turn is correctly interrupted and the tool does not run.
expected: Wording that says the user interrupted it, e.g. 'interrupted while a hook was running, so the call did not run', with no Go error text.
